name: correctness-admin-check
title: Correctness — assignment instead of comparison in an admin check

pullRequest.title: Add the admin audit-event endpoint
pullRequest.body:
Support has been asking for the audit trail in the console. This adds GET /admin/audit-events, gated to administrators, and registers it on the router.

The limit parameter is capped at 200 so a large tenant cannot pull the whole trail in one request.
pullRequest.author: priya-nair
